threads.body: Could you add an `invoke_inline_agent` conformance scenario?

nit: `InvokeInlineAgent` takes `GuardrailConfigurationWithArn`, which only has `guardrailIdentifier`/`guardrailVersion` in every botocore version. `guardrailId` belongs to `RetrieveAndGenerate`'s `GuardrailConfiguration`, so the fallback can never match here.

```suggestion
        guardrail_id = guardrail_cfg.get("guardrailIdentifier")
```

+def _convert_bedrock_parameters_to_json_schema(
+    params: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Convert Bedrock parameter detail map to a standard JSON Schema object."""
+    if not params:
+        return {"type": "object", "properties": {}}
+
+    properties: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    required: list[str] = []
+
+    for prop_name, prop_def in params.items():
+        if not _is_dict(prop_def):
+            continue
+        prop_schema: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        for k, v in prop_def.items():
+            if k == "required":
+                if v is True:
+                    required.append(prop_name)
+            else:
+                prop_schema[k] = v
+        properties[prop_name] = prop_schema
+
+    schema: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "type": "object",
+        "properties": properties,
+    }
+    if required:
+        schema["required"] = required
+    return schema
+
+

+"""Conformance scenario: bedrock invoke_inline_agent."""

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+

+
+from opentelemetry.instrumentation.genai.bedrock import BedrockInstrumentor

+from opentelemetry.sdk.metrics import MeterProvider
+from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
+from opentelemetry.test_util_genai.conformance import Scenario
+from opentelemetry.test_util_genai.instrumentor import instrument
+
+
+class InvokeInlineAgentScenario(Scenario):
+    expected_spans = {"invoke_agent": 1}
+    expected_metrics = ("gen_ai.client.operation.duration",)
+
+    def run(
+        self,
+        *,
+        tracer_provider: TracerProvider,
+        meter_provider: MeterProvider,

+            logger_provider=logger_provider,
+            meter_provider=meter_provider,

+        ):
+            with vcr.use_cassette("test_invoke_inline_agent_conformance.yaml"):
